rationale: The discussion satisfies the bound request within its authority limits. Structure and scope: it leads with the required result card (question, evidence, limitations, next decision), stays at discussion-stage proposal status, and explicitly withholds ratification, launch, backend transfer, publication expansion and follow-up selection. It also correctly limits the older metadata preflight (99 cases / 198 members / zero payloads opened; runner --preflight returns before payload and review-gate checks, consistent with the supplied run.py and receipt) to what it actually proves. Units question: the three-part decomposition (meaning of decoded Tmax values, frozen-loader implementation via np.asarray/dataobj scaling behavior, and input integrity/coverage) is scientifically sound; the starter-notebook evidence is cited with its exact commit 34c66370 and honestly bounded (predates pinned v3 archive, convention support not archive verification, threshold 6.0 unchanged), and contradictory scaling evidence is routed to a separately versioned amendment with review, never silent conversion — exactly the campaign's amendment discipline. Label sealing is preserved: admission preflight does not open follow-up labels, reserved 49 untouched, geometry/binary-label checks remain execution-phase after predictions are written. Pin fidelity: every transcribed identity matches supplied records (spec d76cf92b, code d54e3ea5, decision 78da702d, review 18f6ace7, reviewed commit 469d29df, cohort aba52512, manifest blob edb9a8c2, archive 99014629647/36ae28b9a17f7340b8bbef62b595cb57, snapshot 0770c7dc, source d6a1184b, notebook 1a81c037, decision packet a94d886, operating direction 0690a6d7, selection record 56fa21d4, discussion source 251f899b, task packet 3048557d), correctly marked as transcription. Governance: charter ratification and conditional adoption are treated as recorded and not reopened or re-requested; the approved-but-pending Drive grant is not re-requested; P001 is kept independent of 047 acceptance with pending interpretations supplying no conclusions; historical review is correctly noted as not covering changed dependencies; a passing preflight is correctly distinguished from launch permission and from a scientific result, and evidence gaps (terminal retrieval, unit/scaling verification, Google setup) are kept distinct from reserved operator decisions (launch, backend transfer, writer/reset, spending). Scientific value and negative-result interpretation are stated without invented measurements, literature searches or performance claims, and the specified metrics, bootstrap seed/interval interpretation and two-comparison ceiling are restated faithfully.
